input.summary: Extend the Section 1.4 access/use grant to the Company's Affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf, and carve them (plus a successor transfer right) out of the "no other person" limitation in Section 10.3.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the access and use rights in Section 1.4 to our Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, since our group and outsourced providers operate the Site day to day, and carved them out of the "no other person shall acquire or have any rights" limitation in Section 10.3, which would otherwise strip those rights. We also confirmed the licence transfers to a successor in a merger or sale of assets to protect transaction continuity; if preferred, we can instead cover Affiliates and contractors upon written notice to HDI.

ops.oldText: the right to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated
ops.newText: the right for the Company, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on its behalf to use, a computer system on which the Site will be stored and operated

ops.oldText: for purposes of allowing the Company to monitor current catalog information
ops.newText: for purposes of allowing the Company, its Affiliates and its contractors acting on its behalf to monitor current catalog information

ops.oldText: but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement
ops.newText: provided that the Company may assign this Agreement and the rights granted to it hereunder to a successor in connection with a merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, and that the Company's Affiliates and contractors acting on its behalf may exercise the access and use rights granted to the Company under Section 1.4, and no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement
